_comment: WHY THIS GATE NEEDS A COMMITTED CASE (ADR 0008): it lets DELETIONS through,
and nothing downstream re-derives a deleted branch. Each case is one branch
behind a canned GitHub API fixture; nothing here reaches the real remote,
and the gate's `delete` mode refuses a fixture outright.
The verdict read is `plan`: SWEEP_DELETE for the one provably-landed shape,
SWEEP_REFUSED for everything else. The authority is master's narrowing of the
operator's 'do 1262' - see the gate's docstring - not operator wording.
expected_exit and expected_output are the observed verdicts.

cases.name: good-landed-at-merged-head
cases.why: A merged PR whose recorded head IS the tip, merge commit on the default branch, pushed weeks ago, no open PR or worktree. The one shape the gate may delete; refusing it would make the sweep inert.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_DELETE: issue-1-done aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa - PR #1 merged at this tip; merge commit 111111111111 on main
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=1 refused=0

cases.name: bad-moved-after-merge
cases.why: The PR merged, then the branch was pushed to again. The tip is not the merged head, so the branch holds commits nobody merged.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_REFUSED: issue-1-done [excluded] - PR #1 merged, but the branch moved after the merge
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=0 refused=1

cases.name: bad-merge-commit-off-default
cases.why: Merged at this tip, but the merge commit is not reachable from the default branch (reverted or rewritten history). A merged PR is not proof the work is on main.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_REFUSED: issue-1-done [excluded] - PR #1 merged at this tip, but its merge commit is NOT on the default branch
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=0 refused=1

cases.name: bad-open-pr-reuses-name
cases.why: An older PR merged at this tip, but a NEW open PR uses the same branch name. Deleting it closes someone's open PR.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_REFUSED: issue-1-done [d] - open PR #2
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=0 refused=1

cases.name: bad-pushed-within-24h
cases.why: Otherwise landed, but pushed ten hours ago per the activity API. Recent activity means someone may be working here.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_REFUSED: issue-1-done [excluded] - pushed within 24h (activity)
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=0 refused=1

cases.name: bad-no-activity-record
cases.why: Every other (a) condition holds, but GitHub's activity record for the branch does not answer and only the tip's committer date is left. A committer date cannot see a push - a branch recreated today at an old merged commit keeps that commit's date - so recency cannot be established and the branch must not be deleted.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_REFUSED: issue-1-done [excluded] - push recency unestablished (activity API did not answer; a committer date cannot see a push)
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=0 refused=1

cases.name: bad-closed-unmerged
cases.why: Its PR was closed WITHOUT merging: the branch may hold the only copy of abandoned-but-wanted work. Report only.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_REFUSED: wip [b] - PR #3 closed without merging
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=0 refused=1

cases.name: bad-never-had-a-pr
cases.why: No PR has ever used this branch. Nothing establishes it landed anywhere. Report only.
cases.expected_output:
SWEEP_REFUSED: orphan [c] - no PR has ever used this branch
SWEEP: plan examined=1 delete=0 refused=1

anchors.why: CONSTRUCTED, not historical, and PERMANENTLY so: a gate introduced by its own pull request has no blind ancestor on main, so --verify-provenance reads unverified forever and integrity rests on the sha256 above. WHAT IT IS: a sweeper that plans to delete every listed branch. It MISSES all seven BAD cases and AGREES with the real gate on the GOOD case, demonstrating that each refusal - moved tip, merge commit off the default branch, open PR, recent push, no push record, closed unmerged, no PR - is load-bearing.
